snippet.title: REAPRIEVE | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Reintroducing REAPRIEVE, where the sole purpose of a grim reaper is their desk job. Every soul has a story – and you're tasked with deleting it. This new trailer showcases big updates to the game’s art and gameplay, including main character, Milo! Make sure to snap that QR code and sign up to hear more as it comes.

Follow on Itch: https://10pm-club.itch.io/reaprieve

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
